scope: The Officers’ Stone Quarters, the original limestone building on the south rampart of Fort Mackinac, including its attached lakeside gallery.

originalReview.notes: Unmodified Library of Congress JPEG from the left 1901 original glass negative, with Officers’ Stone Quarters above the long staircase. The original copyright date appears on the survey’s paired negative.

quallaSearch.notes: Checked the published Qualla images first. The distant Lossing views show the fort silhouette, while the circulated modern transfers have uncertain original grants. Used the Library of Congress scan from the original 1901 negative, supported by the signed federal HABS measured plans and elevations.
